the_trade_secret_floor_is_not_merely_unm.proposition: A sensitivity control requires a KNOWN POSITIVE. STATE_OF_THE_ANSWER.md section II asserts that no publicly known ISDS case has pharmaceutical trade secrets or clinical-trial data as the primary covered investment. If that sentence is true there is no known positive in the asset class, so NO sensitivity control for the trade-secret population can be constructed by this council at all. The floor is therefore UNMEASURABLE by this method, not merely unmeasured — and section II bound (3a)/(3d) says 'no floor' and 'unmeasured', which is weaker than the truth.
the_trade_secret_floor_is_not_merely_unm.consequence: The project's central negative can never be upgraded on the search track by firing more controls, however many. Only a primary-register interface — the section IV.2 limit (ii) gap — can move it.
the_trade_secret_floor_is_not_merely_unm.the_nearest_constructible_proxy_NOT_FIRE: Les Laboratoires Servier and ors v Republic of Poland (Award, 14 February 2012, published only in redacted form), carried at analytics/locked_set/VALIDATION_RECORD.md:289 as candidate row 1-02.
